name: Athenaeum InterContinental Athens
insider_take: This sophisticated sanctuary sits in the heart of Athens, where ancient mythology meets modern luxury just steps from the National Garden.
whats_special: The Athenaeum InterContinental occupies a prime position on bustling Syngrou Avenue, originally built as one of Athens' first luxury hotels in 1972. The property features stunning rooftop views of the Acropolis and houses an impressive collection of contemporary Greek art throughout its elegant interiors. Its location places guests within walking distance of both the historic Plaka neighborhood and the upscale Kolonaki shopping district.
pro_tip: Book a room on the higher floors facing north for unobstructed Acropolis views, especially magical during sunset when the ancient citadel glows golden against the Athens skyline.
dont_miss: The hotel's rooftop bar offers panoramic 360-degree views of Athens, while the ground-floor Café Vienna serves traditional Greek coffee in an atmosphere reminiscent of old-world European elegance. The nearby National Garden provides a peaceful escape with hidden ruins and a small zoo, perfect for morning jogs away from the city bustle.
pros: Prime location in Athens city center with easy access to major attractions
Luxury InterContinental brand amenities and world-class service standards
Elegant accommodations with modern facilities and stunning city views
Comprehensive business and leisure facilities including spa and dining options
cons: Busy urban location may not suit guests seeking quiet retreats
